sources.citation: Stanley Schachter, Jerome Singer (1962). Cognitive, social, and physiological determinants of emotional state. Psychological Review.
sources.notes: Foundational primary study (1962) in Psychological Review establishing the core experimental paradigm and quantitative parameters.

sources.citation: Richard E. Nisbett (2000). Stanley Schachter (1922-1997): Obituary. American Psychologist.
sources.notes: Subsequent empirical and theoretical investigation (2000) in American Psychologist extending the foundational findings.

sources.citation: Jack W. Brehm (1988). A Tribute to Stanley Schachter. Contemporary Psychology: A Journal of Reviews.
sources.notes: Subsequent empirical and theoretical investigation (1988) in Contemporary Psychology: A Journal of Reviews extending the foundational findings.

sources.citation: Gary D. Marshall, Philip G. Zimbardo (1979). Affective consequences of inadequately explained physiological arousal. Journal of Personality and Social Psychology.
sources.notes: Replication test showing unexplained epinephrine arousal inherently biases toward negative/anxious affect rather than neutral valence.

sources.citation: Rainer Reisenzein (1983). The Schachter theory of emotion: Two decades later. Psychological Bulletin.
sources.notes: Comprehensive two-decade empirical evaluation of Schachter and Singer's two-factor theory, partial-effect sizes, and misattribution boundaries.

sources.citation: Robert Kunzendorf (2020). In Memory of Jerome L. Singer. Imagination, Cognition and Personality.
sources.notes: Subsequent empirical and theoretical investigation (2020) in Imagination, Cognition and Personality extending the foundational findings.
